reason: E2 confirms shear bands form in HEAs at high strain rates, but none of the cited evidence addresses Co-free FeNiCrMn specifically, nor quantifies dislocation nucleation kinetics, shear band effects on yield strength, or temperature dependence in this system. The premise about comparable performance is unsupported by the cited passages.
